description: Semantically search real sermons on SoapBox that pastors have explicitly opted in to share with AI agents. Returns ranked transcript excerpts with the sermon title, church, speaker, scripture reference, and a start-time (seconds) so you can cite the exact moment. Use this to find what churches are actually preaching on a topic. Only consented, published sermons are searchable.

church_id.description: Optional SoapBox community id to scope the search to a single church.

match_count.description: Maximum number of ranked excerpts to return.

query.description: A topic, phrase, or question to semantically search sermon transcripts for.
examples: how to forgive someone who hurt you

name: search_sermons
